atoms.text: Um im simple past Fragen mit to be zu bilden, wird was oder were an den Satzanfang gestellt.
atoms.sound: Um im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>simple past</voice> Fragen mit <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to be</voice> zu bilden, wird <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>was</voice> oder <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>were</voice> an den Satzanfang gestellt

example.sound: Was Clara at the birthday party?

example.b: Waren deine Freunde in der Bibliothek?
example.sound: Were your friends in the library?

instruction.text: Wähle die richtige Verbform für die Fragen aus.

atoms.text: Die Kurzantworten mit to be setzen sich zusammen aus Yes oder No und der positiven oder negativen Form von was/were.
atoms.sound: Die Kurzantworten mit to be setzen sich zusammen aus yes oder no und der positiven oder negativen Form von was oder were

example.sound: Was he in school? <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>Yes, he was</voice>
Was he sad? <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>No, he was not. No, he wasn't</voice>

instruction.text: Bilde die Fragen und Antworten. Achte dabei auch auf die Satzzeichen.
Ordne den Fragen die passenden Antworten zu.

atoms.a: Did you read the new book?
atoms.sound: Did you read the new book? <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>Yes, I did.</voice>

atoms.b: He was in Italy and visited a friend.
atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>Where was Charly last week?</voice> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>He was in Italy and visited a friend.</voice>
Were they happy? <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>Yes, they were.</voice>

atoms.a: When did Martha call her mother?
atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>When did Martha call her mother?</voice> She called her on Monday.
